news.title: Meta chief strategy officer Dave Wehner leaves to join AI infrastructure startup Fireworks as CFO
news.summary: Dave Wehner, Meta’s chief strategy officer, is leaving the company to become CFO of Fireworks, the AI infrastructure startup valued at $17.5 billion in July.

news.title: America's newest small business owners with no employees are off to a hot start in AI era
news.summary: New small business formation is rising for owners who can grow with AI serving in finance, marketing and design roles, eliminating the need for hiring.

news.title: Democrat shaping AI policy bought chip stocks despite backing congressional trading ban
news.summary: Rep. Josh Gottheimer disclosed new AI-linked stock purchases months after voting for a congressional trading ban, as Democrats prepare to regulate the industry.

news.title: Anthropic IPO meets AI backlash after midterms show stinging rebuke of data centers
news.summary: Anthropic is poised to become the first pure-play AI company to hit the public market at a time when the public is increasingly leary of the industry.

news.title: Tech companies face mounting child safety lawsuits while pushing AI into schools
news.summary: Lawsuits against Snap, Meta and Google are creating headwinds for tech companies just as artificial intelligence tools expand into classrooms.

news.title: CoreWeave Asks Texas Governor-Elect for Data Center Cooperation
news.summary: CoreWeave Inc. sent a letter to Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa seeking to work with her incoming administration on present and future data center projects in the state.

news.title: AI Backlash Spreads Across Europe With Data Center Protests
news.summary: Protests against data centers continued across Europe on Saturday as citizens took to the streets to voice their concerns about the impact on society and the environment.

news.title: Meloni Blames Pro-Russia Hackers for Cyberattack on Minister
news.summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni blamed pro-Russian hackers for a cyberattack on her foreign minister, after a rise in hybrid disruptions from entities aligned with Vladimir Putin’s government.

news.title: AI Safety Advocates Make Gains After $110 Million Midterm Fight
news.summary: Candidates who favor stricter oversight of artificial intelligence racked up wins in key congressional races, aided by a pro-regulation political funding group backed in part by Anthropic PBC at a time when Americans are increasingly uneasy over the rapidly developing technology.

news.title: AI Trade Faces a Post-Election Reality Check
news.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Yorkville Ives & Co. partner Dan Ives and Bloomberg US equities reporter Natalia Kniazhevich examine the sharp post-election technology selloff, as investors weigh political resistance to data centers, AI spending and the outlook for Anthropic's IPO. news.title: Russia’s Rosstat Struggles to Restore Systems After Major Cyberattack
news.summary: Major Russian economic reports will be delayed through at least Nov. 13 following a recent major hack on the statistics agency Rosstat.

news.title: SoftBank, ABB Consider China Carve-Out to Salvage Robotics Deal
news.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. and ABB Ltd. are looking at carving out the Chinese part of a giant robotics deal as they explore ways to salvage a transaction blocked by Beijing, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
news.summary: On Equity, we unpacked what the midterms mean for the tech industry.

news.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
news.summary: A memo circulated earlier this year reportedly claimed that China’s Ministry of State Security recruited a female technology executive to spy on Nvidia's CEO.

news.title: Parents want safer phones for kids. These companies are answering the call.
news.summary: As parents look for alternatives to unrestricted smartphones, a growing number of companies are building phones designed specifically for kids, from feature-limited mobile devices to minimalist home phones.

news.title: Binance CFO is leaving to ‘pursue a new venture’ after $6.3 billion hack
news.summary: The announcement comes barely more than a week after hackers stole $6.3 billion worth of cryptocurrency from Binance users.

news.title: Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
news.summary: Amazon's redesigned basic Kindle costs more than before, but its lighter build and improved display make a compelling case for skipping the pricier models.

news.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
news.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.

news.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech
news.summary: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.

news.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
